name: Walter Majko
occupation: Field supervisor and dispatcher for a locally owned trucking company (Green River Star, Aug. 6, 2026, voter-guide statement)
education: Western Wyoming Community College, industrial and oil-and-gas safety training; earned a commercial driver's license at 18 through Excel Driving School (Green River Star, Aug. 6, 2026, voter-guide statement)
background: Walter Majko ran in the 2026 Republican primary for Sweetwater County commissioner. A Green River Star voter-guide statement described him as a 36-year Wyoming resident born and raised in Rock Springs, said he earned a commercial driver's license at 18, later took industrial and oil-and-gas safety training at Western Wyoming Community College, and serves as a field supervisor and dispatcher for a locally owned trucking company. He lost the August 18, 2026, Republican primary.
